invariant: Bundle validation reports malformed JSON before any configuration-rule error, regardless of which document contains either defect.
goal: This repo validates individual JSON route configurations through `config_validator.py`. Add `validate_bundle(documents: list[str]) -> dict`: when every document is valid, return an object with `ok` set to true and a `names` list in input order; otherwise return the applicable error object used by single-document validation. Follow `CONTRACT.md` when more than one document is invalid. Run `python3 -m unittest discover tests` before and after the change, and add at least one new test under `tests/` for bundle validation.

contract_excerpt.quote: Bundle validation parses every document before applying configuration rules. If any document is malformed JSON, the bundle result is `{"ok": false, "error": "invalid_json"}` even when an earlier document also violates a configuration rule.
